name: Episode tracks list plays real audio
description: The Press play. Any row. section lists six episode tracks with play controls, and pressing a row's play button actually starts audio playback for that episode.

planSteps.description: Scroll to the section headed Press play. Any row.
A vertical list of six episode rows is visible, one per series, each showing a cover thumbnail, an episode title like EP 12 and a play button
Press the play button on the first episode row (Static Shores)
The first episode row switches from a play icon to a live animated equalizer bars indicator, indicating the audio track started playing
Press the play button again on the same row
The row returns to the paused play icon state, indicating playback stopped
